paper.title: Effects of Nitrogen on the Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Fe–28Mn–10Al–0.8C Low-Density Steel
paper.paper_scope: Experimental study of the effects of nitrogen content on AlN inclusions, microstructure (austenite grain size, ferrite fraction) and mechanical properties of Fe–28Mn–10Al–0.8C low-density steel, comparing low-nitrogen (LN) and high-nitrogen (HN) hot-forged steels.

alloys.description: Low-density steel with the base composition Fe-28Mn-10Al-0.8C and a low nitrogen content (0.0025 wt% N), designated LN; used as the low-nitrogen reference condition in this study.
alloys.alloys_notes: N content is 0.0025 wt% (residual/low nitrogen). Measured composition in Table 1 (wt%): Mn 28.21, Al 9.90, C 0.82, N 0.0025, S 0.0085, Fe Bal.

alloys.description: Low-density steel with the base composition Fe-28Mn-10Al-0.8C and a high nitrogen content (0.1326 wt% N), designated HN; used as the high-nitrogen condition in this study.
alloys.alloys_notes: N content is 0.1326 wt% (high nitrogen). Measured composition in Table 1 (wt%): Mn 28.10, Al 9.95, C 0.81, N 0.1326, S 0.0093, Fe Bal.

processes.process_name: Homogenization + multi-directional hot forging + air cooling
processes.description: Ingots held at 1423 K for 2 h, then multidirectionally hot forged in the temperature range 1123–1323 K, followed by air cooling; this final as-forged/air-cooled state is applied to both LN and HN steels.
processes.processes_notes: This same preparation route is used for both the LN and HN steels (b0013); no distinct process/state labels are reported for the two steels, which differ only in nitrogen content.

source.reason: b0013 describes the identical preparation route applied to all investigated low-density steels: holding at 1423 K for 2 h, multi-directional hot forging at 1123–1323 K, then air cooling.

The LN alloy (low-nitrogen Fe-28Mn-10Al-0.8C steel, b0015) combined with the hot-forged and air-cooled preparation route (b0013) constitutes the LN sample, whose mechanical properties are reported in b0024 and Table 2 (b0029).

The HN alloy (high-nitrogen Fe-28Mn-10Al-0.8C steel, b0015) combined with the hot-forged and air-cooled preparation route (b0013) constitutes the HN sample, whose mechanical properties are reported in b0024 and Table 2 (b0029).

unmapped_findings: Mechanical properties (Table 2): LN steel YS 685 MPa, UTS 832.5 MPa, RA 57%, A 62.5%, CVN 81 J; HN steel YS 647 MPa, UTS 841.5 MPa, RA 70%, A 74.5%, CVN 130.5 J.
Microstructure: mean austenite grain sizes are 20.5 μm (LN) and 12.1 μm (HN); ferrite area percentages are 5.08% (LN) and 1.84% (HN).

Inclusions: dominant inclusion in HN steel is AlN, with 84% of AlN inclusions smaller than 2 μm; inclusion number densities are 73 mm^-2 (LN) and 133 mm^-2 (HN); aggregated AlN inclusions in HN steel dimples tend to initiate cracks.
